message.reasoning:
I'm working through a Monopoly cash flow problem—I owe $550 rent but only have $363, leaving me $187 short. I can sell red houses from my properties in Kentucky, Indiana, and Illinois for $75 each, so selling 3 houses would give me $225, bringing my total to $588 and leaving me with $38 after paying rent.

The key constraint is the even building rule: within a color group, I can't have more than a 1-house difference between properties. Since all three reds are currently at 4 houses, selling one from each keeps them balanced at 3 houses each, which is valid and still maintains strong rental income.
